Package org.saidone.protoalf.mcp

Class AlfrescoTools

java.lang.Object
org.saidone.protoalf.mcp.AlfrescoTools
public class AlfrescoTools extends Object
Alfresco operations exposed to the LLM as MCP tools. Results are returned as JSON (protobuf JSON mapping). gRPC errors are rethrown as AlfrescoTools.AlfrescoToolException with a readable message: the MCP server returns it to the client as a tool error (isError: true), so the model can correct its arguments instead of failing the whole conversation.

      @Tool(name="alfresco_update_node", description="Renames a node, changes its type and/or updates its metadata, then returns it. Only the given properties change; properties of aspects (e.g. cm:title) add the aspect automatically. The type change is applied before the properties, so properties of the new type can be set in the same call. Use alfresco_list_models to find the types and their properties.") public String updateNode(@ToolParam(description="Node to read: a nodeRef (workspace://SpacesStore/<id>), a bare node id, or one of the aliases -root- (Company Home), -my- (user home folder), -shared- (Shared Files)") String nodeRef, @ToolParam(description="New name, omit to keep the current one",required=false) String name, @ToolParam(description="New type, e.g. a custom document type; omit to keep the current one.     • readContent

      @Tool(name="alfresco_read_content", description="Reads the content of an Alfresco document. By default returns its plain text (\'text\'), extracted by Alfresco from PDF, Office, HTML and the other formats it can convert; with binary=true returns the stored bytes base64-encoded (\'contentBase64\'). Long content comes in slices of at most maxBytes bytes: while \'hasMore\' is true, call again with offset = \'nextOffset\'. \'size\' is the total size in bytes (of the extracted text in text mode). FAILED_PRECONDITION means the document format cannot be converted to text.") public String readContent(@ToolParam(description="Node to read: a nodeRef (workspace://SpacesStore/<id>), a bare node id, or one of the aliases -root- (Company Home), -my- (user home folder), -shared- (Shared Files)") String nodeRef, @ToolParam(description="Return the stored bytes base64-encoded instead of the extracted text (default false)",required=false) Boolean binary, @ToolParam(description="Byte offset to start from: 0 for the beginning, then the nextOffset of the previous slice",required=false) Long offset, @ToolParam(description="Slice size in bytes, 1..2097152 (default 100000)",required=false) Integer maxBytes)

    • search

      @Tool(name="alfresco_search", description="Searches the Alfresco repository with an AFTS (Alfresco Full Text Search) query and returns the matching documents and folders with their metadata. Examples: \'budget\' (name, title, description and content), \'cm:name:\"report*\"\' (name starting with report), \'TEXT:\"invoice 2024\"\' (content), \'TYPE:\"cm:folder\" AND cm:name:\"projects\"\', \'TYPE:\"cm:content\" AND cm:modified:[NOW-7DAYS TO NOW]\', \'PATH:\"/app:company_home/cm:Projects//*\"\' (everything below a folder), \'cm:creator:\"jdoe\"\'. Combine clauses with AND, OR, NOT and parentheses. Results come from the search index, which may lag a few seconds behind recent changes. \'totalItems\' is the number of matches; check \'hasMoreItems\' and increase skipCount for the next page. Results are sorted by relevance unless \'sort\' is given.") public String search(@ToolParam(description="AFTS query, e.g. cm:name:\"budget*\" AND TYPE:\"cm:content\"") String query, @ToolParam(description="Number of results to skip (paging offset), 0 for the first page",required=false) Integer skipCount, @ToolParam(description="Page size, 1..1000 (default 25)",required=false) Integer maxItems, @ToolParam(description="Sort order: comma-separated \'field [asc|desc]\', applied in order (ascending by default). field is a property (e.g. cm:name, cm:modified, cm:created) or score (relevance). Example: \'cm:modified desc, cm:name\'",required=false) String sort)

    • listModels

      @Tool(name="alfresco_list_models", description="Lists the content models of the Alfresco data dictionary with their types and aspects (name, title, parent, mandatory aspects). Use it to discover which types exist (e.g. for TYPE:\"...\" in alfresco_search) and, with includeProperties, which metadata properties a type or aspect accepts and their data types (for the properties of the create/update tools). Without \'model\' it lists every model, without properties. With \'model\' (a namespace prefix such as cm, or a model name such as cm:contentmodel) it lists that model only. Properties are those a type/aspect defines itself: inherited ones are on its parent. readOnly properties cannot be set.") public String listModels(@ToolParam(description="Namespace prefix (e.g. cm) or model name (e.g. cm:contentmodel); omit for every model",required=false) String model, @ToolParam(description="Also list the properties of each type and aspect; requires model",required=false) Boolean includeProperties)
